messages.subject: CPD seminar: Recent developments in IP licensing (4 Nov, 12:30)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

A reminder that the IP team is running a lunchtime CPD seminar on recent developments in technology and IP licensing next Tuesday at 12:30 in the 5th-floor training room. Sandwiches provided. Worth 1 hour of CPD. Let me know if you'd like a place.

Donna
